rows.heading: 1. Skill engine (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Skill appears on its first level-up (51 XP), each milestone level runs a hand-written reward (stat, title, recipe, other skill multiplier) with a "NEW PERK" announcement.
rows.notes: First actual native level gate, category/picker filtering, and 26 explicitly authored first-level stat perks where milestones were absent.

rows.heading: 2. Item engine (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Holding a threshold stack of a material (50 Cure Grass) teaches a recipe once via an onGet hook, then the hook disarms.
rows.notes: Twenty held Golmoon leaves teach Weak healing powder. Explicit optional actor fact and a stable native recipe availability ID; chest/trade publication stages knowledge before durable save. Learned preparations reveals separately.

rows.heading: 3. Books and manuals (Proto23)
rows.mechanism: Reading time shrinks with Literacy, and finishing certain books unlocks a whole UI view (Bestiary, Journal, Marketplace).
rows.notes: Literacy scales study work and remaining time, while restore uses exact raw progress. ABC for kids or Old combat manual completion reveals Reading reference and opens existing Journal/Bestiary. Stop retains partial progress.

rows.heading: 3. Actions, rest, sleep, jobs, training
rows.mechanism: Run and Investigate are free toggles granted by milestones; a known action stays listed with a current reason it cannot run.
rows.notes: Running level 1 grants Run; Perception level 1 grants Investigate. Known rows retain current blocked reasons. Investigate delegates to the original Local life owner.

rows.heading: 10. Startup and misc
rows.mechanism: Opening is a staged reveal: each introduction response shows the next panel (time, stats, inventory, nav/log, enemy panel).
rows.notes: Existing first-fight Combat reveal from d49cb911 retained. Additional opt-in staged presentation opening is off by default and persists browser introduction progress, without replacing the original beginning.

rows.heading: F1: Meaningful events reveal the interface
rows.mechanism: Real events reveal panels: first recipe shows Assemble, first skill shows Skills, first fight shows the enemy panel, wallet reveals money.
rows.notes: Existing Combat gate retained. Skills, practiced actions, learned preparations and reading reference have real-fact discovery gates and no unknown picker labels; Classic also respects undiscovered gates.

rows.heading: F4: The strongest pattern is a chain from experience to capability to UI
rows.mechanism: Walking practice levels, grants Run, which reveals the Actions tab; holding 50 Cure Grass teaches a recipe and reveals Assemble.
rows.notes: Native practice to level 1 to Run/Investigate to Practiced actions, and currently held herb stack to recipe to Learned preparations, implemented through native owners.

rows.heading: F4: The strongest pattern is a chain from experience to capability to UI
rows.mechanism: Use a wallet to reveal money denominations; a book grants a Bestiary/Journal view.
rows.notes: Familiar frontier purse remains unchanged. An unfamiliar world shows readable raw coin counts until a real money settlement records per-world knowledge; denominations then remain known. Book-completion reference view also lands here.
